input: Find team sports (soccer, basketball, baseball, softball, volleyball, football, lacrosse, ultimate) summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville summer 2026 soccer basketball volleyball camps
Asheville soccer summer camps 2026 ABYSA HFC
Asheville summer sports camps Enka Reynolds North Buncombe 2025
Enka high summer camps basketball volleyball 2026

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 Ultimate Sports camps included basketball, flag football, soccer and volleyball at Burton Street Center.

candidates.name: Asheville Buncombe Youth Soccer Association (ABYSA / Highland Football Club)
candidates.town: Asheville, Candler, Mills River, Hendersonville and Mars Hill
candidates.note: FUNdamentals and competitive soccer camps; 2025–2026 offerings covered multiple Buncombe, Henderson and Madison County fields.

candidates.name: UNC Asheville
candidates.note: North Asheville campus offers youth and teen baseball, basketball, soccer and volleyball camps and clinics.

candidates.name: T.C. Roberson High School
candidates.note: 2026 South Asheville camps included baseball, basketball, football, girls’ lacrosse, soccer, softball and volleyball.

candidates.name: A.C. Reynolds High School
candidates.note: East Asheville school published youth summer sports camp registration materials for both 2025 and 2026.

candidates.name: Enka High School
candidates.note: July 2026 Jet Volleyball Camp served boys and girls in rising grades 2–8.

candidates.name: Asheville Christian Academy
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camps offered athletics alongside STEM, fine arts and academic enrichment.

candidates.name: Warren Wilson College
candidates.note: 2026 basketball camps taught shooting, passing, dribbling, footwork and defense with college coaching staff.

candidates.name: Asheville Football Club
candidates.note: 2026 competitive soccer camp for boys and girls offered four training days at Warren Wilson soccer fields.

candidates.name: KP Volleyball Training
candidates.note: 2026 volleyball camps and beginner-to-high-school clinics used Hominy Baptist Church and FernLeaf’s Wilderness Campus.

candidates.name: Xcel Volleyball Performance
candidates.note: Organization advertised 2026 summer volleyball camps; its current site lists activities at T.C. Roberson High School.

candidates.name: Crossfire Ministry
candidates.note: Announced 2026 Monday–Thursday afternoon basketball camps, with Asheville and Hendersonville identified as anticipated locations.

candidates.name: Ultimate Frisbee Summer Camp
candidates.note: Mark Strazzer runs youth ultimate camps at Carrier Park and high-school preseason camp at Asheville Middle School; 2026 activity confirmed.

candidates.name: URJ 6 Points Sports Academy
candidates.note: West Asheville overnight camp offers basketball, baseball, soccer, volleyball, softball and lacrosse; summer 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: Summer 2026 soccer day camps served ages 6–16 in Black Mountain; college also lists basketball and other athletic camps.

candidates.name: PGC Basketball
candidates.note: June 29–July 3, 2026 Scoring College at Mars Hill University accepted incoming grades 9–12.

candidates.name: Mars Hill University
candidates.note: University summer opportunities page lists basketball, baseball and soccer camps for school-age students.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: 2026 basketball camps included half-day sessions for ages 6–8 and full-day sessions for ages 9–14.

candidates.name: Waynesville Hollers
candidates.note: Baseball organization published a 2026 summer camp announcement on May 27, 2026.

candidates.name: Western Carolina University
candidates.note: 2026 university summer listings include WCU Athletics sports camps and Campus Recreation’s Lil’ Cats camp.

candidates.name: U.S. Baseball Academy
candidates.note: Asheville–Weaverville summer baseball camp listing identifies instruction in hitting, pitching, fielding, baserunning and catching.
